_comment: « حصّة القسم » — the DEFAULT class tests of lesson « القسمة الإقليدية وحصر حاصل القسمة » (2AM; docs/architecture/CLASS_SESSION.md). `start` opens the hour: what the lesson stands on (the 1AM Euclidean division: quotient, remainder, the remainder smaller than the divisor), then two questions of the NEW lesson (`teaser`: a quotient by a two-digit divisor, the trips NEEDED — asked again at the end, with other numbers). `end` closes it on the three الكفاءات of the lesson: dividing by any number, bracketing the quotient between two consecutive whole numbers (the values by default and by excess), a remainder 0 (a ÷ b a whole number, « a مضاعف للعدد b »). `pool` holds more prepared questions a teacher may add to his own copy. Every question carries a `check` from which its answer is RE-COMPUTED by a test (defaultTests.test.js): a default test never ships a wrong answer. The numbers are the platform's own (none of the lesson's world). A class test never changes a student's progress.
